_readme: An asset registry: what each file is, where it came from, and whether it is
cleared for publication. content.json points at filenames; this file records
what those files are. Keep them in step.
Approved assets are append-only: a new or reprocessed image gets a new
filename and a new entry. Never overwrite a file that has already shipped.

assets.role: Scene 1 hook — Girne harbour and castle from a terrace
assets.notes: Must read as Girne. Do not substitute generic coastline or Karpaz beach imagery.

assets.role: Scene 1 intent layer — Mediterranean living room
assets.notes: Intent layer only. Never presented as the £165.000 listing.

assets.role: Scenes 3–4 main listing card and detail hero; Scene 5 staged room
assets.notes: Also the staging_after image — same room as room-00-bos.jpg.
Only the card edge is visible; not read as a listing.

assets.role: Scene 5 empty room, the 'before' side of the slider
assets.notes: Geometry, camera, windows and floor must match room-01-akdeniz.jpg exactly.
Rendered with filter: invert(1) on the navy closing card, i.e. the white variant.

unused_in_this_reel.reason: part of the source set; not referenced by the final V7 cut
style reference only — explicitly excluded from the final video

rules: Disclosure is mandatory on AI-visualised interiors: the Scene 5 pill reads 'AI ile görselleştirildi · Temsilî'.
Never present a generated interior as a specific real listing's photograph.
Do not alter a room's geometry, window proportions, camera angle, ceiling height or door openings between a before/after pair.
No asset with unclear licensing enters assets/approved/.
